transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, yeah, good to meet you too. Um... well, what finally pushed me to come in is that I just can’t seem to organize all the moving parts anymore. I mean, at work, it's just... it's a lot. Patent notes, workshop prep, gallery deadlines for my wife—oh, she’s an artist, mostly mixed media, really incredible stuff. We actually just went to this gallery opening last weekend downtown, the one near that old Italian place? They have the best garlic knots, honestly, I could eat them for every meal. But anyway, yeah, the deadlines, the team decisions... I just end up starting whatever is loudest instead of what actually matters. Like, I’ll be trying to focus on a piece of code, and then an email pings, and suddenly I’m down a rabbit hole about, I don't know, mechanical keyboards. Did you know there's a whole subculture for those? I spent three hours last Tuesday just watching videos on different switch types... but yeah, the organization thing is just falling apart.
Did you have these same kinds of focus and organization problems when you were a child?

Yeah, actually... looking back, it was definitely there in grade school, long before I was a teenager. I remember my parents kept all my old report cards in this big plastic bin in our basement. The basement always smelled like cedar because my dad built this huge storage closet down there... he was really into woodworking. Actually, I tried getting into woodworking a few years ago, bought a lathe and everything, but I just never set it up. It’s still sitting in the garage taking up space. 

But anyway, the report cards! Yeah, my teachers would always write the exact same thing. They’d say I was a bright kid, but that I daydreamed constantly. And the frustrating part is I’d actually do the work. Like, I’d finish the worksheets or whatever, but then I’d just... forget to turn them in. Or I'd completely lose my homework folders. I had this one folder, it had the Thundercats on it—man, that was such a great show. Did you ever watch the reboot they did a while back? The animation style was totally different, kind of anime-influenced, which some people hated, but I thought the line work was pretty crisp... wait, what was I... right, childhood focus. Yeah, losing folders, daydreaming, forgetting to hand in finished assignments. It’s been happening since I was little.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energized or high for several days in a row?

Unusually energized? No, I don't think so. I mean, I'll get excited about things, sure. Like when I first started learning about espresso extraction. Oh man, I went down such a rabbit hole with that. I bought this fancy burr grinder, the kind they use in actual cafes, and I spent an entire weekend just calibrating the grind size to get the perfect crema. Did you know that humidity actually affects how the coffee beans grind? It’s wild. If it’s raining outside, you literally have to adjust your settings. My wife thought I was losing my mind because I was pulling like, twenty shots a day just to test the variables. I didn't even drink them all, obviously, I'd be vibrating through the walls if I did. But no, I wouldn't say I feel unusually high or anything for days on end. Just... really interested in things sometimes.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about everyday things?

Worrying excessively? Um... I don't really think so. I mean, I stress about normal things, like deadlines or... or making sure the cars are inspected on time. Actually, speaking of cars, I just took my Subaru in last week because it was making this weird rattling noise near the heat shield. The mechanic said it was just a loose clamp, but it got me looking into how exhaust systems are put together. I ended up watching this documentary on the history of the catalytic converter. It’s actually fascinating how they use precious metals like platinum and palladium to filter out the toxic gases. I guess palladium prices have been all over the place lately because of supply chain issues. My brother-in-law is really into investing in commodities like that, he’s always talking about silver and gold at family dinners. It gets a little exhausting, to be honest. He’s got this whole theory about the gold standard... but anyway, what was the question? Oh, worrying. Yeah, no, I don't think I'm an overly anxious person or anything like that. Just the normal stuff.
